subject: Culture
title: Digital Afterlives
description: A micro-lesson that makes Digital Afterlives usable.

hook.text: Facebook has over 30 million profiles of dead people. By 2070, dead users may outnumber living ones.

buildup.text: Digital estates include email, social media, crypto wallets, and cloud storage. Death creates an inheritance problem.

discovery.text: AI chatbots trained on a dead person's texts can mimic conversation. Families talk to synthetic copies of the deceased.

twist.text: South Korea created a VR experience where a mother 'met' her deceased daughter in a virtual garden. She cried on camera.

climax.text: We're building digital ghosts without cultural frameworks to manage them. Technology outpaced the rituals we need.

punchline.text: The dead now live longer online than they did in the ground.

quiz.question: How many dead people have Facebook profiles?
